name: How much does a workers' compensation attorney cost if my claim was denied?
description: Workers' comp attorneys usually work on a contingency fee, meaning they are paid a percentage of your benefits if they win, with no upfront costs.

mainEntity.name: How much does a workers' compensation attorney cost if my claim was denied?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most workers' compensation attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront fees, and the attorney's payment is a percentage of the benefits or settlement you receive. If your attorney doesn't win your case, you generally don't owe them a fee. In California, these fees are typically set by the Workers' Compensation Appeals Board, often ranging from 9% to 15% of your permanent disability benefits and other recovery. This structure ensures legal representation is accessible regardless of your current financial situation.
